findings.message: The supplied evidence establishes the signature and result variants, but shows no implementation of the required decision behavior: routing approval/rejection to models.approve/models.reject, preserving daemon refusal reasons, and converting failures into Failed without throwing. These executable contract requirements remain unimplemented in the evidence.

The required caller updates are unimplemented in the supplied evidence: no note shows ModelTiersSection, PerRoleSection, PerRepoSection, and InsrcSettingsConfigurable all matching `is SaveResult.Saved` and displaying rejection detail when present. Type declarations and test intent alone do not satisfy this postcondition.

The evidence shows failure types and UI surfaces, but no implementation of the required unavailable-daemon path: catching DaemonUnavailableException as Failed(NotRunning), displaying the prescribed message without editable rows or writes, and retrying on Refresh. This required error case remains unimplemented on the supplied evidence.
findings.expectationRef: LLD error case 1: The daemon is not running when the settings page opens or Refresh is pressed

findings.message: The supplied evidence does not show the required expired-check response implemented: an unknown-check refusal must tell the user that the check is no longer pending and offer Check again. Available state and a test name establish intent, but do not establish this dialog behavior.
findings.expectationRef: LLD error case 6: The check expired or the daemon restarted before the decision

findings.message: The evidence shows supporting helpers and state, but no implementation of the required unset-tier behavior: display the default family's tier default, remain clean, and produce no Apply writes. This expectation remains unimplemented in the supplied evidence.
findings.expectationRef: LLD edge case 4: A tier with nothing configured

findings.message: The supplied evidence shows the family-selection surface and cliKind metadata, but does not show the required CLI-only filtering implemented. The check dialog must exclude Ollama from its offered families.
findings.expectationRef: LLD edge case 7: Choosing Ollama in the check dialog

findings.message: The evidence shows Apply entry points and per-tier saved/pending state, but no implementation of off-EDT execution, baseline advancement gated on Saved, or a ConfigurationException naming the failed tier. These required behaviors are unimplemented in the supplied evidence.
findings.expectationRef: LLD invariant 1: Apply runs off the EDT and advances a tier's baseline only when its write Saved; a failed tier keeps its pending edit and Apply throws a ConfigurationException naming it (jetbrains-plugin/src/main/kotlin/ai/insors/insrc/jetbrains/settings/ModelTiersSection.kt:70).

findings.message: The evidence shows component-rendering helpers and a live-daemon test declaration, but no executed runIde walkthrough. It also does not establish coverage of approve + restart or Apply with restartRequired, comparison against the LLD UX mock, or recorded screenshots of every required state. Complete and record the sandbox IDE walkthrough required by t10.
